description: Assembly source code implementing cryptographic functions for Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) operations, including initialization, multiplication, and hashing, optimized for ARM architectures in BoringSSL's cryptography module.

methods.name: gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the Galois field multiplication table for ARMv8 architecture, loading input H, computing H^2, and storing precomputed values.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of input Xi with the hash subkey H, optimized for ARMv8.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using ARMv8 NEON instructions, processing blocks and performing modular reduction.
